svg.title: Allocate a $30,000 Reference Startup Budget Across Four Buckets
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-30000-reference-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate a $30,000 Reference Startup Budget Across Four Buckets; subtitle: Compare $8,000 lean, $30,000 reference, and $60,000 expanded plans.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: This illustrative $30,000 reference opening cash allocation sits within the $8,000–$60,000 USD startup capital range; it is not a required portfolio size or an annual expense forecast. Numeric values are reference-plan dollars. Each plan allocates 50% to acquisition inventory, 10% to research and transaction setup, 10% to renewal and transfer reserves, and 30% to operating runway. Lean and expanded amounts are shown in each bucket. Do not add these buckets to the annual waterfall as though all cash deployed were current expense.; caption: Lean: $4,000 + $800 + $800 + $2,400 = $8,000. Reference: $15,000 + $3,000 + $3,000 + $9,000 = $30,000. Expanded: $30,000 + $6,000 + $6,000 + $18,000 = $60,000. At $500–$5,000 monthly operating expense, the reference $9,000 operating reserve covers 1.8–18 months, excluding inventory purchases and separately reserved renewals and transfers.; stages: label: Acquisition inventory; value: Lean $4,000; reference $15,000; expanded $30,000; 50%; numeric value: 15000.0; detail: Allocate $4,000 of the $8,000 lean plan, $15,000 of the $30,000 reference plan, or $30,000 of the $60,000 expanded plan. Deploy gradually into researched names and capped auction bids; retain a per-domain basis ledger rather than marking unsold inventory to asking prices.; label: Research and transaction setup; value: Lean $800; reference $3,000; expanded $6,000; 10%; numeric value: 3000.0; detail: Allocate $800 of the $8,000 lean plan, $3,000 of the $30,000 reference plan, or $6,000 of the $60,000 expanded plan. Reserve for comparable-sale tools, historical-use research, targeted rights review, and initial transaction setup; release funds against scoped work.; label: Renewal and transfer reserve; value: Lean $800; reference $3,000; expanded $6,000; 10%; numeric value: 3000.0; detail: Allocate $800 of the $8,000 lean plan, $3,000 of the $30,000 reference plan, or $6,000 of the $60,000 expanded plan. Ring-fence cash against registrar renewal schedules, premium-name charges, and transfer costs; revise the reserve as holdings and renewal dates change.; label: Operating runway reserve; value: Lean $2,400; reference $9,000; expanded $18,000; 30%; numeric value: 9000.0; detail: Allocate $2,400 of the $8,000 lean plan, $9,000 of the $30,000 reference plan, or $18,000 of the $60,000 expanded plan. Support contractor work, inquiry handling, and routine administration while sales remain uneven. First-deal timing is 2–9 months; the reference reserve covers nine months only at monthly operating expense of $1,000 or less. At $5,000 monthly, even the expanded operating reserve covers only 3.6 months.

rect.title: label: Acquisition inventory; numeric value: 15000.0; value: Lean $4,000; reference $15,000; expanded $30,000; 50%; detail: Allocate $4,000 of the $8,000 lean plan, $15,000 of the $30,000 reference plan, or $30,000 of the $60,000 expanded plan. Deploy gradually into researched names and capped auction bids; retain a per-domain basis ledger rather than marking unsold inventory to asking prices.

label: Research and transaction setup; numeric value: 3000.0; value: Lean $800; reference $3,000; expanded $6,000; 10%; detail: Allocate $800 of the $8,000 lean plan, $3,000 of the $30,000 reference plan, or $6,000 of the $60,000 expanded plan. Reserve for comparable-sale tools, historical-use research, targeted rights review, and initial transaction setup; release funds against scoped work.

text.title: Research and transaction setup: Lean $800; reference $3,000; expanded $6,000; 10%
text.tspan: Research and transaction setup: Lean $800; reference $3,000; expanded $6,000; 10%

rect.title: label: Renewal and transfer reserve; numeric value: 3000.0; value: Lean $800; reference $3,000; expanded $6,000; 10%; detail: Allocate $800 of the $8,000 lean plan, $3,000 of the $30,000 reference plan, or $6,000 of the $60,000 expanded plan. Ring-fence cash against registrar renewal schedules, premium-name charges, and transfer costs; revise the reserve as holdings and renewal dates change.

text.title: Renewal and transfer reserve: Lean $800; reference $3,000; expanded $6,000; 10%
text.tspan: Renewal and transfer reserve: Lean $800; reference $3,000; expanded $6,000; 10%

rect.title: label: Operating runway reserve; numeric value: 9000.0; value: Lean $2,400; reference $9,000; expanded $18,000; 30%; detail: Allocate $2,400 of the $8,000 lean plan, $9,000 of the $30,000 reference plan, or $18,000 of the $60,000 expanded plan. Support contractor work, inquiry handling, and routine administration while sales remain uneven. First-deal timing is 2–9 months; the reference reserve covers nine months only at monthly operating expense of $1,000 or less. At $5,000 monthly, even the expanded operating reserve covers only 3.6 months.
